anomalies.observed: On the I2C Sensors sheet, the EC EZO circuit (M5) VCC and the non-isolated RTD EZO circuit (M2) VCC are both labeled NET0097; the RTD VCC net is tied to the +3V3 rail, and U5 (ADM3260 for EC) VDDISO is also on that same NET0097 supply net.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires each isolated EZO channel to have its own isolated supply: "each with a dedicated isolated supply (/V_pH, /V_EC) and isolated ground (/GNDISO_pH, /GNDISO_EC)" and the EC supply must be "galvanically separate from the main +3V3/+5V/+24V domains."

evidence.quote: I2C Sensors / Electro Conductivity Sensor: M5 ATLAS_EZO_EC ... VCC NET0097; Water Temperature Sensor: M2 ATLAS_EZO_RTD ... VCC NET0097; U5 ADM3260 VDDISO connected to NET0097
each with a dedicated isolated supply (/V_pH, /V_EC) and isolated ground (/GNDISO_pH, /GNDISO_EC) ... galvanically separate from the main +3V3/+5V/+24V domains.

anomalies.impact: The EC isolated domain is merged with the non-isolated RTD/+3V3 supply, defeating the intended galvanic isolation and likely powering the EC circuit from the wrong rail. This can create ground loops, corrupt the isolated I2C channel, and prevent reliable EC measurements.

anomalies.observed: The ATO valve low-side switch is drawn as T7 AO3400A.
anomalies.expected: The specification selects an AON6407 N-MOSFET for the ATO solenoid-valve switch: "T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch".

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: A lower-rated small-signal MOSFET is used in the 24 V solenoid position instead of the intended AON6407. The AO3400A's roughly 30 V VDS rating gives little margin on a 24 V inductive load and may lead to avalanche stress or failure during valve switching.

anomalies.observed: The Water Height Sensor section shows PR4 LIDAR wired to H8 and connected to the main I2C nets NET0019/NET0056.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF-Luna LiDAR is documented but not wired: "its pins ... typed free ... it is not connected to any net", and the intended wired water-level sensor is an ultrasonic sensor on GPIOs: "water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs."

evidence.quote: Water Level Sensor/Switches / Water Height Sensor: PR4 LIDAR ... H8 PB_1.25mm ... NET0019, NET0056
its pins ... typed free ... it is not connected to any net in this design
water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs

anomalies.impact: The board implements a LiDAR on the main I2C bus instead of the specified unwired-LiDAR/ultrasonic arrangement. This adds an unintended I2C device and leaves the firmware-expected ultrasonic level interface absent, so water-level behavior may differ from the reference design.

parsed.summary: The schematic appears to contain deviations from the intended design: the EC isolated supply is merged with the non-isolated RTD/+3V3 domain, the ATO valve MOSFET is a lower-rated AO3400A instead of the specified AON6407, and the LiDAR is wired to the main I2C bus despite the specification saying it is not wired.
